description:
rynekpierwotny.pl brings Poland's new-build housing market into ChatGPT. Describe the apartment you're looking for in your own words — city, budget, number of rooms, completion date — and the app searches current developer listings and returns matching offers with prices, key details and links, right inside the conversation. No extra account and no filter forms: if you have ChatGPT, you can start searching.

What you can ask:

"Find a 3-room apartment in Kraków under 700,000 PLN, ready in 2026."
"Show me flats in Warsaw close to a metro station, with a balcony."
"Compare these two projects — price per m², completion date, developer."
"Now narrow it down to the ground floor with a garden." — ChatGPT keeps the context of the conversation, so you refine your search instead of starting over.

Every result comes from the rynekpierwotny.pl database of offers published by developers themselves
